minutes.headline: Commission approved the 1010 Mass Ave deck on condition materials are supplied; the outreach letter was debated, with no vote heard.
minutes.summary: The Architectural Preservation District Commission met with three members in the room. It discussed the 1010 Massachusetts Avenue certificate (CTA) for a deck addition, and a motion was made to approve it once the owner supplies materials. Most of the meeting was a long disagreement over mailing a notification letter to district property owners now versus after the November town meeting bylaw revision; it ended with an agreement to see a draft bylaw change in August.

why_it_matters: Owners of property in the Architectural Preservation District may get a notification letter later than planned, and the November town meeting may be asked to vote on a bylaw revision that changes which projects need review.
The fee and public-notice questions touch what a homeowner pays to get a small project like a deck reviewed, and the record here does not show whether the approval passed.
